'''Voidspace''' is a dimension that exists inside [[Aleph-1]]. It is an abstract realm that exists beyond linear causality and the laws of time and space, where anything that had been consumed by Aleph-1 now permanently resides within the space itself. This realm is explored by [[Aemeath]], who explains what lays within the dimension.

==Archive Entry==
{{Description|A high-dimensional domain embedded deep within high-density Voidmatter, existing "inside" Aleph-1. The fundamental laws of time and space descend into total chaos here. Any living entity entering this domain suffers a rapid loss of frequency, eventually leading to the total dissolution of their existence.|Glossary}}

==Overview==
[[File:Voidspace4.png|thumb|339x339px]]
Voidspace is a dimension that resides within the [[Threnodian]], and was unknown to humanity until it appeared on [[Solaris-3]].<ref name="AEMEATH">{{Quest|The Star That Voyages Far}}
:'''''Aemeath:''' I was shocked at first. But the moment I stepped into Voidspace it all made sense.''
:'''''Aemeath:''' This distorted, black hole of a realm where time and space are warped... it appeared when the Threnodian came to Solaris.''
:'''''Aemeath:''' Anything lost inside can exist in multiple moments at once. Things caught in it can be thrown into junctures of time they were never part of.''</ref> However, it is inaccessible to humanity at the moment. This is primarily because for one to enter Voidspace, a high-concentration of Voidmatter is required. Aemeath describes the greater depths of Voidmatter as a severe [[Void Storm]] manifesting and a portal into Voidspace itself—a higher dimensional plane.<ref name="VS">{{Quest|The Star That Voyages Far}}
:'''''Aemeath:''' Yes. Think of a severe Void Storm as a manifestation and portal into Voidspace itself—A higher dimensional plane. It's pitch-black, but also like a kaleidoscope.''
:'''''Aemeath:''' Inside, time and space aren't linear. Everything is warped.''
:'''''Aemeath:''' Things the Threnodian devoured from different eras can be sitting right next to each other.''</ref> However, it's because the Voidmatter concentration is too high, humanity is unable to enter the realm as Voidmatter indiscriminately dissolves all matter and existence within its range. 
[[File:Voidspace2.png|thumb|339x339px]]
Just falling into Voidspace can cause one to be consumed, erased from existence.<ref>{{Quest|The Star That Voyages Far}}
:'''''Aemeath:''' The Voidmatter concentration down there is too high. If you fall into Voidspace, even you could be consumed. Erased from existence.''</ref> Any probes that had been sent previously cannot enter the depths of Voidmatter in higher concentration, leaving research on the substance scarce. Only Aemeath reached it because she was already dead, as no living soul can withstand a place like Voidspace. 
[[File:Voidspace3.png|thumb|339x339px]]
By her description, upon exploring the dimension, the realm is essentially a graveyard of civilizations Aleph-1 already ended. Time is chaotic with the addition of space being warped in Voidspace, where anything lost inside can exist in multiple moments at once. Things caught in the realm can be thrown into junctures of time they were never part of.<ref name="AEMEATH" /> Within the space itself everything is pitch-black, but like a kaleidoscope, where inside, time and space aren’t linear. Everything is warped where things the Threnodian devoured from different eras can be sitting right next to each other due to the laws of time and space being disconnected from normal physics.<ref name="VS" /> Although, because of this unique trait, Aemeath discovered that if the conditions are met, one can initiate time-travel within the realm itself. Though, it should be mentioned that attempting this is difficult and very dangerous.

Aemeath, when attempting to finalize the time-loop she was a part of, could feel her body breaking down despite previously stating that Voidmatter cannot touch her, suggesting that the Voidmatter concentration is high enough that her own soul was at risk of collapsing, forcing her to [[Overclocking|Overclock]] to succeed. 

However, anything that finds itself within Voidspace doesn't fade away immediately. Numerous Roya and [[Spacetrek Collective]] members who were devoured claim they can feel other individuals presence, but cannot see them nor hear, though thoughts replace sound. Many eventually faded, though during the crisis upon Aleph-1's attempt in entering Solaris-3, the devoured humans managed to create coordinates within Voidspace by working together despite the impossibility of such an act by coordinating and passing on their work towards those within until they succeeded and gave Aemeath the required knowledge for her to pass onto [[Rover]] so they and both the Roya and Spacetrek Collective may translate and decode the coordinates to locate the [[Exostrider]] to defeat Aleph-1. 

With the defeat and banishment of Aleph-1, entering Voidspace has become nigh-impossible now with current methods; Arman claims however the future is yet unknown with the potential to one day access Voidspace despite Aleph-1's banishment.
